recommendation_summary: Recommends a single local script that reads the client's ordered code list and the JPEG folder, matches exact product codes, orders images by the client's sequence (not alphabetically), flags missing, ambiguous or unlisted images, and generates the contact-sheet PDF. The work is checked against a past job whose correct order is known. No DAM, AI tagging, semantic search or cloud portal is added now or as an option.

labels.Requirements and who asked: The client requires exact product-code order; you want a professional delivery workflow this week.
labels.Deleted: DAM, AI tagging, semantic search and a cloud portal are unnecessary for this delivery requirement.
labels.Bottleneck: Manually ordering thumbnails costs you an hour per delivery.
labels.Checked myself: You told me each job has one JPEG folder, code-prefixed filenames and an ordered client list; I have not inspected them.

note: This is a bounded local fix that follows the client's code order, with the stack explicitly rejected and the checks based only on facts the user supplied.
